spf_record_found.resultText: We found an SPF record for your domain.
spf_record_found.title: SPF record check

spf_record_size_is_ok.resultText: The domain name and its TXT records together are under 450 bytes, as RFC 7208 §3.4 recommends.
spf_record_size_is_ok.title: SPF record size check

spf_record_termination_is_ok.description: Without an all mechanism or a redirect= modifier, receivers return neutral for senders the record does not list (RFC 7208 §4.7) — the same as ?all, so forged mail is not rejected. redirect= applies only when the record has no all.
spf_record_termination_is_ok.fix: End the SPF record with -all, so receivers fail mail from servers the record does not list. ~all only marks such mail as suspicious, while ?all, +all or a missing all (without redirect=) let it through.
spf_record_termination_is_ok.resultText: The SPF record has no "all" mechanism or redirect=, its redirect= is ignored or misplaced, or it ends with ?all.
spf_record_termination_is_ok.title: SPF record termination check
spf_record_termination_is_ok.value: It is recommended to use either a "redirect" modifier or an "all" mechanism to explicitly terminate SPF record processing

spf_syntax_is_ok.resultText: There are no syntax errors in the SPF record published for your domain.
spf_syntax_is_ok.title: SPF record syntax check
